prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable word 120px · one-line width 120px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 69px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 118px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 993px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 604px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 603px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"列出常用化学试剂的身份、纯度和储存要求，供查找、核对及安全存放时使用。","reading":"读者可先按名称查找，再沿同一行核对分子式、CAS 号、纯度和储存条件；储存说明较长，通常需要多行，形成的行高可容纳其他单元格适度换行。","groups":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号共同标识试剂，其中分子式和 CAS 号用于精确核对。","纯度与储存条件分别说明试剂规格和保管要求，均应与对应试剂保持清晰的行关联。"],"keep_intact":["分子式和 CAS 号应分别保持完整，避免在标识符内部断行。","纯度数值、百分号及范围宜保持在一起；试剂名称也应尽量完整。"],"may_wrap":["储存条件是自然语言说明，可在词语或标点处换行。","纯度等级与百分数之间可换行；较长的中文试剂名称必要时可换行。","储存条件表头可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [108, 141, 90, 84, 180] · table 604×1092px · row heights [33, 154, 154, 154, 154, 134, 154, 154] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [128, 141, 90, 75, 169] · table 604×1092px · row heights [33, 154, 154, 154, 154, 134, 154, 154] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [95, 141, 90, 75, 202] · table 604×951px · row heights [33, 134, 134, 134, 134, 114, 134, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"分子式和 CAS 号完整，表头清楚；名称列容纳了大多数名称，储存说明与对应试剂的行关联明确。","problems":"长名称分成两行；纯度范围被拆成两行，加上等级共占三行。储存说明普遍占七行，左侧短内容下方留下较大空白。","cause":"名称列为 108px，容不下最长名称的 107px 内容及边距；纯度列为 84px，容不下完整范围；储存列为 180px，长说明需要频繁换行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"128px 的名称列让最长试剂名称保持一行，分子式和 CAS 号也完整，便于按名称查找和核对。","problems":"纯度范围仍被拆开；储存说明较窄、行内文字密集，长名称以外的名称单元格则显得宽松，整表行高与 r1A 相同。","cause":"名称列增至 128px，占用了储存列的空间；储存列缩至 169px，纯度列仅 75px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"202px 的储存列让长说明更易连续阅读，最高单元格由七行降至六行，表格整体更紧凑；分子式和 CAS 号仍保持完整。","problems":"最长名称分成两行，纯度范围分成两行，核对范围时不够顺畅；部分储存文字在词语中间换行。","cause":"名称列压至 95px，纯度列为 75px；更多宽度分配给储存列，使标识和纯度列的余量不足。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"范围优先","widths":[95,141,90,90,187],"change":"以 r1C 为基础，将纯度列增至 90px，争取让百分比范围完整；名称仍可分两行，储存列保留较宽的阅读空间。"},{"name":"名称与纯度","widths":[128,141,90,90,154],"change":"让最长名称保持一行，同时增加纯度列宽以容纳范围；检验储存列缩窄后，名称完整性是否值得增加说明的换行。"},{"name":"均衡试探","widths":[108,141,90,90,174],"change":"保留 r1A 较从容的名称列，增加纯度列宽，并给储存说明留出 174px；比较名称换行位置及储存说明的行数和节奏。"}]}
